contract: WINGA CONVERSATIONS SECURITY & REALTIME CONTRACT v1.0
inputNote: User replied naangalia while looking for the remainder. No missing sections are invented.

requirements.title: CORE ARCHITECTURAL DECISION
requirements.evidence: Platform commerce/auth remains outside Phoenix; canonical PostgreSQL writer/event ledger and supervised bounded Phoenix service exist. Deployed failure/capacity acceptance remains open.

requirements.title: SECURITY PRINCIPLE
requirements.evidence: Native encrypted path stores ciphertext/proofs/metadata. Explicit legacy plaintext compatibility remains; this is not universal E2EE deployment acceptance or retrospective encryption of old history.

requirements.title: DO NOT INVENT CRYPTOGRAPHY
requirements.evidence: Established MLS implementation and WebCrypto/noble primitives are reused; this audit adds no custom crypto. Integration/library independent review remains required.

requirements.title: PROTOCOL EVALUATION
requirements.evidence: Signal/MLS/OpenMLS/native/browser tradeoffs are documented. MLS/ts-mls candidate is integrated and pinned, but reviewed production-library selection and physical mobile acceptance are not complete.

requirements.title: C/C++ CRYPTO CORE
requirements.evidence: No Winga C/C++ crypto core is selected. Do not invent one to tick conditional requirements. Relevant dependency/parser/browser and independent protocol review still applies.

requirements.title: MEMORY SAFETY REVIEW
requirements.evidence: No Winga C/C++ crypto core is selected. Do not invent one to tick conditional requirements. Relevant dependency/parser/browser and independent protocol review still applies.

requirements.title: DEVICE IDENTITY
requirements.evidence: Device-generated nonextractable Ed25519 identity, owner/session-bound public registry, pending approval and revocation tombstones. Replacement is represented by native retirement/revocation, not a new registry REPLACED enum.

requirements.title: DEVICE REGISTRATION
requirements.evidence: Device-generated nonextractable Ed25519 identity, owner/session-bound public registry, pending approval and revocation tombstones. Replacement is represented by native retirement/revocation, not a new registry REPLACED enum.

requirements.title: ADDING A DEVICE
requirements.evidence: Canonical native register/approve/revoke changes persist one deduped generic own-account notification in the same transaction. Existing notification/SSE infrastructure and device manager are reused; registered/revoked timestamps are separate own-account metadata. No invented device name/type, key details in notices or silent approvals. Physical device acceptance remains open.

requirements.title: DEVICE REVOCATION
requirements.evidence: Native epoch/device admission/removal/replacement freezes writers and requires retained/new authorized endpoint acceptances. Revoked devices are denied; deleting a socket is not the crypto membership transition.

requirements.title: IDENTITY VERIFICATION
requirements.evidence: Full fingerprint obtained independently is required; pinned package identities are checked and changed keys cannot silently inherit trust. QR and key transparency are not established by fingerprint UX.

requirements.title: MESSAGE ENVELOPE
requirements.evidence: Versioned signed native operation wraps MLS ciphertext, routing and optional opaque media reference. Private content/keys remain at endpoints.

requirements.title: MESSAGE IDENTITY
requirements.evidence: Logical UUID and exact ciphertext are staged before transmission; server adopts the validated UUID as its canonical encrypted message ID. Matching retries return the same row; different binding conflicts. This is not two independently allocated IDs.

requirements.title: DURABLE ACK CONTRACT
requirements.evidence: Canonical store responds after withTransaction commit. Direct client partial ACK gap fixed: committed ISO time and decimal server sequence required before SENT/outbox retirement, matching existing Room validation. Eight invalid-ACK cases retain exact work; actual isolated HTTP/PGlite reload reconciliation proves one row.

requirements.title: DELIVERY STATE MACHINE
requirements.evidence: Pending/exact retry and sender/recipient signed message-state evidence exist. A socket attempt is not Delivered; own sibling sync is not peer Delivered/Read. True receipt can independently reconcile accepted work; physical UI/state acceptance remains open.
